reviews.text: I came into the clinic after my Yorkie, Milo, was accidently stepped on. It almost tore his nail completely from his paw. Understanding Milo was in pain, the hospital took me in quickly. They also reviews Milo's panels before putting him under sedation which was really important to me. The levelof care and service was exceptional. Thank you to the entire team!!
Great affordable service, great staff. Daisy says thank you!

If I could give zero stars, I absolutely would. My dog was neutered here, and ever since leaving the facility, he’s been dealing with a serious infection. I’m now on my third vet visit in less than 10 days and we’ve spent damn near 2000 dollars just trying to deal with the the complications. The place itself was honestly gross, and it makes me question whether their cleanliness and sanitation practices contributed to the infection. The staff have been rude and unhelpful. Every time we call with questions about recovery, we get a different answer.

Made an appointment someone called to change the appointment. I asked them to send me an email with the new appointment because I was driving. They never did. Tried to call could not get through, sent an email 2 days no response. Called again talked to someone who had no idea when my appointment was and could not tell me.  I used them before and it was fine, however, this was the worst service I have ever received. I would rather pay more than use these  people.
Don’t not come for anything, my cat died just for getting her fix.

My kitten got spay and neuter 8/05/2026 when we arrived to check him in what was suppose to be just a drop off and pick up turn into a you really need to have this and that done on him be for he gets surgery it really is necessary I told the lady my cat had everything done already gave her all the paperwork I had prove  that he had bloodwork done for leukemia she kept insisting they needed a resent one so I gave in because she said is required be for surgery I wanted surgery to be done for him I felt she really push it on me and pretended not to see the document  receipt cashier says Krista R I’m not sure if is her she was there at 11am I want a refund this ain’t right charging for something that was done already and you saw paperwork of I will be reporting this to the Better Business Bureau if I don’t get refunded make it right they told me to talk to the manager she’s only there on Wednesday’s her names J  I will be talking to her future clients be aware of your extra charges when manager is not there they say they can’t do nothing about it I will update on Wednesday hoping they make it right I should have check there reviews there’s complains about this and animals dying after surgery we want the best for our fur baby’s check the reviews be for thinking of coming here we came because our rescuer had the appointment hear we trusted her and she trusted them she even got upset at the extra charge they pushed on me if it was already done and they had the paperwork on it

The facility itself was clean and the staff were generally pleasant, but my experience with the pricing was disappointing. The advertised price was not what I ultimately paid. Additional fees were added for items such as “excess tissue” and because my pet was reportedly “in heat,” increasing the total by roughly $45 or more per item. None of these extra charges were made sufficiently clear upfront, so the final bill ended up significantly higher than expected. Prospective customers should ask for a detailed written estimate of all possible add-on charges before agreeing to treatment. So for this I can’t give a great review. Still ended up spending $600 regardless. Then they mentioned the previous shots were insufficient when they were given 2 months ago by another clinic which o had to pay additional.

The San Diego Spay and Neuter Clinic provides excellent service. The staff is friendly and very Knowledgeable. The prices are very reasonable and affordable. I had my dog neutered and vaccinated. The entire process was easy and well organized.

Took my pug here for her spay and overall had a good experience. The staff was friendly and everything felt organized, even though it was definitely busy. They have a system in place — I’d recommend filling out paperwork ahead of time, allowing extra time for parking, and expecting a bit of a wait.

I’m giving 4/5 stars mainly because I wouldn’t really consider the pricing “affordable.” By the end, the total was just under $800 with add-ons and additional charges, especially for brachycephalic dogs. To be fair, the pricing details were provided upfront in the paperwork, so nothing was hidden — the clinic name just set different expectations for cost.
Had a dental here for my dog. Prices are reasonable. Definitely recommend.
Cat was neuter here. I would recommend for sure. Prices were low and was not a hassle like the snap bus is.
Go here! Low prices and they do many spays and neuters so they are pros
Had my dog spayed here. It’s very affordable and so easy. I booked online.

Affordable Spay and Neuter Clinic was speedy, informative, kind and the vets were certified-not students. I felt very comfortable getting my pup spayed here and I am thankful for their affordable services!

A big shout out to everyone here at the clinic... they're awesome, especially Julia and Raquel! That couldn't have been more kind and helpful. We had a pair of kittens spayed and neutered recently, they took great care of them.
Thanks so much guys! 😊
What a great experience. Julia is always there to help with all my need with my dogs. I appreciate her dedication to her job. People like her make me know not all vets have to be stressful

The staff at North Park Spay and Neuter are the most professional and kind to animals. I would recommend them to anyone needing spay or neuter services. Very informative staff and very reasonable prices.
Very helpful staff, also beat my vet’s price by $400!

Why can't I give this place of "business"ZERO stars?

Take your fur baby to the SD Humane Society Vet Clinic, where you'll receive actual affordable, decent, honest service.

You will be quoted $550, "no hidden fees." I paid $750. Good thing I checked the box "call before doing extractions“ (make sure you do this) bc I received a call from Crystal & was quoted over $3300. Granted, my cat has a lot going on with his teeth, hence the $750 dental appointment. I asked which extractions would be absolutely necessary. She puts me on a brief hold to ask the doctor & comes back with "the doctor would like to know how much you have to work with and is willing to work with that."

The audacity.

Never met the doctor; who is the doctor? Conveniently hiding behind their poor staff. At least most of them were decent; most likely dying of embarrassment of how this establishment is ran.

I received a call at 11AM, after dropping my cat off at 7:30 AM with the hellacious $3K quote. I was told I'd be given a call back within the next couple hours to pick him up. Nobody ever called me back. Good thing I showed up by 5PM because they were wondering why I didn't come, followed by embarrassment & endless apologies for not following through with a call to pick him up.

I did you all a favor by wasting my money here and posting this review so you don't have to.
You have my dog but can’t answer a phone? I’ve been calling for hours and no answer, no voice mail, no nothing. What’s going on???

I am writing this review to formally address a concern regarding the pricing and advertising of your dog neutering services.

Your website lists the cost for this procedure as $25.00. However, upon attending my appointment, I was informed that the actual price is $175.00. Due to this unexpected increase, I was unable to proceed with the service, and was subsequently told that my initial $25.00 payment would not be returned.

The discrepancy between your advertised rates and the final quoted price is misleading. As the service was not provided at the rate specified on your website, I am requesting a full refund of my $25.00 deposit.

I look forward to your prompt response regarding this matter.

Regards,

Lupe R
They do a great job! Totally recommend.

I took my almost 2yo GSD here who does PPD work. They were so accommodating to his needs/temperament and made us feel very comfortable. Definitely recommend this place, great staff, good price, overall very caring and thoughtful employees who made the process for me and my boy a smooth and peaceful one.

had such a great experience at this clinic. I brought my dog in with several skin issues, and I was honestly worried about his condition. From the very beginning, the team was incredibly attentive, caring, and knowledgeable.

They not only treated him during the visit, but also provided a complete treatment plan for me to continue at home. I could see improvement very quickly, and his recovery has been going so well ever since.

You can truly tell they care about the animals and take the time to do things right. The level of care, professionalism, and attention to detail is outstanding. I’m so grateful I found this place and would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for high-quality care for their pets.
Staff is friendly and they take good care of your friend in need at an affordable rate. I have a large breed dog and some places would not spay him because of his size.they took him in no problem.

Lots of hidden charges. They advertised Base Service but I realized after all said and done I had paid more than double what the base service costed. Seemingly by signing a consent to treat they can just add things as extras to your bill even though the base cost still had required payments like a catheter for 45.00 and a cone for $20. $90 for anti nausea does not seem very affordable to me and an additional $45 for swelling after I was told that the surgery took longer even though my pet was released at the same time I was quoted on originally. I don't think people like to be misled when it comes to money I certainly didn't. 430$ later I realized this was a pretty expensive place to go to contrary to their misleading title.
Very professional and personable staff. My kittens were in great hands and recovered well!
They don’t answer their phone calls

We took out kittens in to get fixed. One neuter, and one spay. The staff was friendly and helpful. It's been a while since we've had to go through the exercise of getting cats fixed, but As Affordable Spay & Neuter reassured us and guided us through their efficient and expedient process. Our kitties are recovering well. Highly recommend this place for this service!

i will never recommend this place never will they killed my precious cat blu back in 2025 and Dr chou sent her home with internal bleeding so if you want your pet to not come home the same way they left then yes i recommend this place they’ll kill your pets at a charge of maybe $150-$200
They have wonderful customer service and took very good care of my fur baby.

We are extremely grateful to the entire team for the exceptional care they provided to our dog, Stella, especially Dr. Campbell. From start to finish, the staff was kind, professional, and incredibly compassionate. Dr. Campbell took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of our questions, and made a very stressful situation much more manageable.

Stella was treated as if she were their own, and the level of medical care and follow up gave us complete confidence and peace of mind. She is recovering well thanks to their expertise and dedication. We highly recommend this clinic. BIG SHOUT OUT TO ALL THE STAFF!
Got my kitty spayed here. Very easy to book. Very affordable. Employees are compassionate and patient.

Nothing against the staff members, they were so sweet and definitely seemed to be compassionate towards my cat. However, unless you are truly tight on funds please don’t take your animal here.. this was very traumatic for me and my cat. They are low cost clinic so they take a high number of pets to do surgery on in a single day. There were over 30 cats there when I was dropping off and the dogs are dropped off earlier so I don’t even know how many dogs were there, however in the 8 hours I find it incredibly disheartening to even consider doing 50+ surgeries in one day in a 8 hour period. My cat was left in his cage on a shelf before surgery for who knows how long with no water, and then stuffed back in his small crate after surgery. I picked him up completely saturated in his own urine and poop. And even after five days he is scared to come out of hiding and has been completely different. He was incredibly traumatized and I will personally never take another pet here just for the price. My pets wellbeing is way more important and I’m disappointed in myself for using this clinic to save money.
The staff were very sweet, quick and professional. They took good care of my boy and made sure to provide lots of instructions for help in the aftercare of his surgery, i couldnt be more grateful :)

My two 6 month old kittens got spayed and neutered here about a month ago and they are healthy and healed. So while everything turned out ok, the process could have been better.

First a lot of reviews complain about the cost of add ons. I was not upset at the add ons, this is a high volume clinic and their website has all the information on pet requirements and possible add ons. I did the research, so there were no surprises there.

We brought in our male and female kittens on a Friday. At around 2:00 we received a call that they would not operate on our male kitten as he swatted at the vet. I was surprised to hear that they would not take an 8 pound kitten out of the carrier because he swatted. But, I don’t work at a high volume clinic so I am not aware of the potential risks there. What was particularly upsetting was when they called us two hours later to let us know they were not operating on our female kitten either. She did not swat, and while they wouldn’t give us a straight answer it appeared they felt since we had to take the male back the female could be done at another time as well. We had planned for this to be the day of the surgery and taken off work after the weekend to spend with her as female cats take longer to recover. I was very disappointed we were not a part of this decision and both my husband and I had to take work off again the next weekend because they elected to skip our female cat.

We took them back the next Friday and they both received the operation. While their incisions were healing fine, the tattoo they gave our male cat was deep and starting to bleed and look infected. We ended up having to take him to our regular vet and get antibiotics for the tattoo, not the incision.

While we saved money on the procedure, we both had to take an extra day off work and pay for antibiotics because the tattoo they gave our cat was too deep. So it’s hard to say if the savings were worth it. Looking back I wish I did more research on other vets and would have spent more for a better experience. I also wish I would have asked them not to tattoo our cats as that became more of an issue than the incision itself.
Great experience. Staff was kind and efficient. Thank you!
Great exp with our pup!  The staff was super friendly and amazingly organized!

I normally don’t complain about places, but this one truly broke my heart. The customer service supervisor was dismissive, and the intake worker rolled her eyes at people on the phone. Staff were laughing off customers’ concerns and patience while dogs stood outside in the heat, anxious and confused.

At one point, they asked me to weigh my own dog and then walked away, showing complete negligence and disregard for proper care. I arrived at 7 a.m. for my scheduled appointment and didn’t get a call until 4 p.m., only to find out my dog was never even seen and never had the surgery. I left my dog there for nothing.

To make matters worse, the $50 deposit I paid in advance was nonrefundable. I did read that policy, but given the circumstances, it feels like they use it to take advantage of people who genuinely want affordable care for their pets. They nickel and dime you for every little add-on, and it’s hard not to question whether the animals actually receive the care being promised.

The place looks run-down, disorganized, and uncaring. What hurt the most was how my dogs came home. They hadn’t even had surgery, yet they were trembling, wide-eyed, and afraid to be touched. Seeing them recoil from me after being there for hours was devastating.

Who knows what you would see if cameras were reviewed or how the dogs are treated when owners aren’t around. I left feeling sick to my stomach, disappointed, and heartbroken for what they must have experienced inside. I wouldn’t be surprised if a representative tries to respond here with a generic mission statement or excuse to save face, but no words can undo what I witnessed or how my dogs were treated.

The process was simple, get clip board, stand in line and wait for them to call you. All aspects of the process was explained throughly and staff were helpful and answered all questions. My doggo is recovering well!
It's very impressive that they beat competing vet offices by 3 times the price. My puppy Jedi's surgery went great!

tldr:
overall happy with my spay experience for my 6 month old puppy. thank you to the staff that are able to keep this place running! the price i payed was comparable to sd humane- with optional care included! i would recommend this place if you understand this is a high volume, low cost clinic and are able to discern which add-ons are necessary, if any, for your dog.

if you’ve chosen to get your dog fixed here:
come prepared knowing you’ll have to leave time to find parking, that everyone checks in at 8:30, and that you’ll need your current vaccinations at hand. i’d recommend printing and filling out the paper work at home and planning to arrive at 8am so you can park in the lot. they will explain aftercare to you at pickup. checkup exams are not necessary, but are free within the first two weeks of the surgery.

if you are still thinking about committing, consider:
- will your dog need fluids during surgery?
- will your dog need famotidine & metoclopramide, or cerenia during surgery, or trazodone after?
- is your dog up to date on vaccines?
- is your dog on a prescription flea & tick preventative? (necessary, will incur fees for tablet if not)
- is your dog in heat? (will incur fees)
- is your dog aggressive, or possibly unfit to receive anesthesia? (may be denied after an exam fee)
- in the unlikely event of an emergency, what should the vets do?
- any extra services are totally optional, and if you want to keep the cost low, just say no! they’re offering additional services for your convenience since your dog will already be in veterinary care: nail trim, bloodwork, microchip, extra vaccines, dewormer, etc.

the route i chose:
we don’t have an e collar at home. my pup is healthy and up to date with vaccines and flea & tic meds, but has a history of dehydration. i wanted to keep her comfy but balance the price of the service, so i chose:
+ e collar $20
+ extra care (fluids) $40
+ cerenia $60
these add-ons plus the base price of $165 came out to be $263. (sd humane: $230.)

TL,DR: SDA Spay has *much* room for improvement. Do your pet a huge favor, and schedule with the Humane Society instead.
SDA Spay is...
1. DISORGANIZED: Just because you schedule for a specific time on their website, it does not mean that you will be called in that order, nor does it guarantee that your pet will get spayed/neutered that day. It also appears they overbook because we had some people saying they were returning from the week before. You have to line up early and it's more first come-first serve style. The line itself is hardly a line because dogs are whining nonstop and owners are having to pull their dogs left and right. //vs The Humane Society has clear instructions and there's only a few dogs scheduled each day.
2. NOT ACTUALLY AFFORDABLE: We were expecting a $200 cost as listed on their website but they charge extra fees for everything (IV fluids, exam fee, temperamental fee, nausea meds, "required" blood work, sedation meds, credit card fee). They also charged for a flea medicine even though we told them that she had just gotten her flea treatment and was not due for it. It ended up costing ~$400. // vs The Humane Society does not charge extra fees. The cost on their website is the price you pay.
3. FILTHY: As soon as you walk into the clinic, it smells very musty. The kennel area was extremely haphazard and reeked of poop and pee. I wanted to leave right then and there but we had already paid. // vs The Humane Society is much nicer and cleaner. The kennel area is more spacious and does not smell.
4. NOT FOR THE ANXIOUS/REACTIVE: In the scheduling application, they ask if pets are reactive, but they do not follow-up to make sure we have a plan for a successful surgery day. When we dropped our dog off at 7am, we offered to leave her with the muzzle, but they said we could not. We got a call at 2:30pm saying they could not operate on our pup because she was "too anxious to let anyone touch her". In the end, they made us reschedule and prescribed anti-anxiety meds to give her the night before and morning of (of course, for an extra cost). // vs The Humane Society has a note section on their application where we indicated our dog's anxiety and they called to tell us to administer anti-anxiety meds. When we dropped her off for her surgery they took the time to ask us what we thought would be best for our dog. They let me walk back with her and hold her while they gave her the pre-surgery sedative shot.

I took my 1 year old dachshund to get spayed and it was a very easy process. I was able to book the appointment online and drop off and pick up was pretty fast. My dog took the night to recover and has been doing really well. You would never know it’s only been two days as she is already back to her happy self. It was an expensive process but now I have the security of knowing that she is fixed and microchipped.
I highly recommend the affordable spay and neuter clinic for your fur baby. They did an exceptional job taking care of my kitty cat.

We were initially scheduled, brought our cat and were called in the afternoon and told that they had to reschedule us. We showed up to our rescheduled apppointment and at 5p they called to tell us that they hadn’t spayed our cat again. She came home with a runny nose and diarrhea. Do not come here if you have choices.

I took my kitten there over a year ago, everything has been until yesterday, all of a sudden she’s hiding from me, won’t even eat temptations, then I notice her go to the litter and this clear mucus is coming out of here, long story short, she hasn’t peed or pooped in 2 days now or ate and I just left her at an ER hospital paying $4k but the crazy thing is the receptionist came out earlier and asked me if she was spayed and I said why do you ask me that the vet earlier today asked me that 3 times and now you why is that, she goes cuz they think they see a uterus, I go she was spayed over a year ago. That’s a lot of left over tissue if they’re saying that, so she’s in ICU right now doing some other tests then an ultrasound but I swear after reading all these other horror reviews, enough is enough. I wish I would have read the reviews before I went there, I’ll find out more when they most likely have to remove the rest of her uterus,. Spend the extra money I wish I had
So far Ive brought three cats here to get spayed, they always do a good job.

Each person I encountered was so patient, kind and helpful. I wasn’t really sure what to expect, and felt a bit unprepared. But the staff kindly walked me through the paperwork and the process. They took great care of my 2 “babies”. My cats recovered quickly and are back to their normal, adventurous lives.

Affordable cost means affordable quality. They'll ask for a deposit in addition to payment up front, and then the hidden fees. If you dont want to DNR your pet you must sign a waiver that let's them tack on any fees they want. You'll be allowed to schedule cats before the allowed time for appointments that seemingly dont get made. You'll then receive a text that youll have to arrive hours later than you planned.

They will forget to put a collar on your cat even though you paid, makes you wonder how responsible they are with what you cant see.

2/5 solely for performing the operations
Would recommend saving yourself the trouble if you arent very local
I took my foster boy Tucker in today and Jai was so patient and kind with us. Highly recommend if you are in the San Diego area.

Excellent clinic! I was nervous (and feeling guilty) about having my Toy Poodle spayed. After some searching for a reasonable cost clinic I found Affordable Spay and Neuter Clinic. The staff was very great about reassuring me that it is in the best interest of the dog to be spayed and helped put me at ease.  Procedure was done in a timely fashion and my pet has made a fast and easy recovery. Would definitely recommend and use this clinic for any future needs.

The price is good and my pup was ready in 5 hours. The staff was great and super nice. My only issue: my appointment was at 8am, they don't open until 8:30am, I was 1st in line but they had the medicated pups 1st(which I understand), but then they called the female dogs in next and made our wait much longer. So they didn't take my pup in until about 9am. I just wish it would have explained that process on their site so I could plan better. Aside from that, I had a great experience there.

A few important issues to consider:

-Price is around $300 total with medications and other items needed

-When you arrive at 7:30am, you will sit and wait for at least 90 minutes in a parking lot with 20 other dogs doing nothing

-Your dog will then sit in a small crate for 8hrs+ (mine sat for 9.5hrs, dropped off at 9:15am and picked up at 6:45pm, and many others came after me, which is not okay for any animal) with no water, food and no bathroom break, (when I picked my dog up she had urine all over her which was not explained by the staff-absolutely disgusting and unsanitary) and only to be completely traumatized by the whole situation

-The place is not managed well, overcrowded with appointments, and there is no interest in the welfare of your animal, which is very dangerous and inhumane, read other reviews for evidence

-Lastly, go somewhere else and pay more money so your dog is well taken care of...low cost means low care

0 star rating, my dog passed away due to getting fixed here and she was perfectly fine before this procedure. It’s an easy and simple procedure and I don’t understand how this happens. I’m so upset and I’ll never be the same without my girl. Please do not come here.

OUR DOG JUST PASSED! DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOG HERE TO GET SPAYED! 08/05/2025

My sister just took their dog here TWO days ago (08/05/2025), Her dog Dutchess has passed today due to sepsis fluidin the lungs! PLEASE DO NOT GO HERE! My sister is Absolutely torn and has lost her pet! Her dog was unresponsive today and she took to emergency vet, she passed an hr later!! I tried calling to notify and no one is answering!!

Don't listen to the detractors. This is a high volume clinic that is very efficient. Had my 8 lb Chihuahua neutered here just a couple days ago and they were excellent. All in cost was $201 for neuter ($130), I bought the e-collar because  I didn't have one, ($18), flea medicine ($15), and the extra care package which included catheter and IVs for $35. $3 for CC fee. He had zero nausea, barely any pain, and was eating and drink normally by the next day. Spent most of the day resting.

I'm very happy with their service and the staff treated my furry friend kindly the entire time.

All around great experience! Easy and efficient check in / check out. They’ll give you everything you need to know before and after the procedure.

Out the door cost was about $300, including anti nausea and sedative medication. Regular vet quoted $1,100 so it was a no brainer

Highly recommend

Highly recommend if you're looking for an affordable alternative to spaying and neutering your fur babies. I was a little nervous based on some reviews, but it was actually quite organized. If you follow all the instructions from the email and post-op, everything should be fine. It didn't take that long for them to check everyone in, maybe 30 mins tops. Her wound is also healing nicely. 24 hours and she's already back to her normal self!

A year or so ago my folks got a puppy. They got the dog neutered and microchipped by this business. When my dad later requested the microchip code to register it online, they made getting the code difficult. They wanted another visit with the dog to scan his chip to figure out the code, but my dad never followed up on it. While in the vets office TODAY, my dad mentioned the dog had a chip, but they didnt know the code. They scanned the dog and found out he was never microchipped. This business had billed my parents the $35 without actually doing the procedure, and was banking on getting the dog back in the building to actually chip him. The ball was dropped multiple times along the story, but the fact remains that this business did this to our dog, and may have done it to others. I'm sure my parents thought somewhere along the line, a lost dogs chip could be traced back to a business before it was traced back to them. But the only reason why I am posting this review is so people know they did this to at least one dog. Our dog was the first one in the building when they opened for his procedure, and he was one of the last dogs picked up before they closed. We think he was overlooked and ignored for most of the day, and this would explain the microchipping, or lack thereof. If you've used this business for microchipping, I'd recommend double-checking.

Took my kitten to be neutered. The process was very easy, from making the appointment, dropping him off, and picking him up. They give you clear instructions on caring for your per after their surgery. My kitten is making a speedy recovery and has no I'll affects to his procedure. I highly recommend them.

First, this place is a mess. Absolutely no organization when it comes when to managing picking up my pet. I waited by the phone all day and no one called. I finally resigned to show up at 5 before closing for my pet and the staff said they “called” and left a voicemail. No one called or left a voicemail. She was sitting for over two hours because they “called” and there was no answer. When I asked what number they called they didn’t want to answer and then went on to say they don’t even know who called and if it was done. She has multiple numbers on her collar if they needed to call another number.

As a clinic that takes in a high volume of animals- communication needs to do better. What I and my pet experienced was incompetence and laziness. I will not be recommending this org and I only had to go through here because of rescue contract terms.
No frills clinic, but they get the job done. Great price and my dog did well under their care.

The ladies here are so sweet and communicative! They kept me informed 100% throughout my cat’s exam and neuter and they never did anything without asking me first. I appreciate the affordability and easy process !

Took 2 of my cats on different days. Each appointment had to be rescheduled. I was reassured that my procedure will be top priority when I come back in for the reschedule. And my cat was indeed taken in as soon as I got there, both times. There are signs in the clinic and reminders online and in the emails they send, that they are high volume and what not. So it shouldn't be surprising. I spend 280  and around 260 for each of my cats. I got some extra stuff and shots I paid extra for. But that's roughly what you should expect to pay if you want your cat to be comfortable during and out of surgery. They did not tac on any fees that I didn't want. Only thing is they should call or email if they plan on rescheduling, because me and other people showed up only to be turned away. It happened twice, and both times they said "you should have gotten a call"

"Very nice people! I really feel they care about the animals. Even though the clinic can get busy with many people bringing their pets, you can see the love they have for them. They treated my cat well, even though it was a bit challenging for me to go through the process with her. I appreciate their kindness and dedication!"

I am TERRIBLY DISGUSTED with this place , and the treatment both my poor kitty and I received. If there was an option for zero stars, believe me .. I’d put it. As most of you know by already reading the reviews and seeing what kind of reputation this place has, most of us are still trying to get our animals fixed for a low cost. As that was exactly what I was trying to do. However, this place is the farthest thing from “affordable” or “safe” for your pets. My kitten sat in his crate on a cold metal shelf for 5-1/2 hours before anything was done with him. At that, I received a call and got told that only one of his testicles were descended. The receptionist continued on by asking if I would be willing to pay an extra $200 to have the other one that’s all the way up in his stomach removed too. Mind you , real licensed vets should be able to find out this information before ever performing anything on your pet. After I declined the extra $200 , she stated that they were gonna go ahead and just neuter the 1 testicle. About 30 minutes later, I receive another call stating that if I am declining to pay the $200 that they can’t do the surgery at all and I can come pick up my cat anytime. I then replied with okay , as I have been sitting in their parking lot for around 8 hours. Once I go in, she did issue me a refund but stated I would have to wait another 2 hours to get my cat back. I then asked why is that, since he didn’t receive any treatment today? She replied stating that they administered him anesthesia and he will have to recover from it.
